messages:
auditor_jane: Hi team — auditor here. For the SOC2/ISO evidence package we need RBAC changes + KMS usage for prod between 2024-10-01 and 2024-10-14. Specifically: rolebinding diffs, KMS decrypt/Encrypt logs, key rotation proof, mapping to incidents and approval tickets. Prefer a signed manifest + a 10% raw-sample export for forensics.

maria: Ack, I can take point. Quick Q — do you want raw logs (full) or a packaged manifest + sample raw exports? Signed manifest is fine.

auditor_jane: Manifest + sample raw exports is ideal. Manifest should include sha256 for each artifact and a presigned link.

sam: For RBAC diffs we can pull cluster audit logs. Example Splunk query I'll run and attach CSV:```index=clusters earliest="10/01/2024:00:00:00" latest="10/14/2024:23:59:59" sourcetype="k8s_audit" | spath output=verb path=request.verb | spath output=object path=request.objectRef.resource | search (verb="create" OR verb="delete" OR verb="update") object="rolebinding" | table _time, user, verb, object, namespace, request.user.username, request.objectRef.name```

ashley: KMS decrypt/Encrypt events come from CloudTrail -> CloudWatch -> Splunk. For rotation proof we'll export CloudTrail events where eventName IN ("EnableKeyRotation","RotateKey","DisableKeyRotation") and include the `awsRequestId` + management event details. To snapshot policy: `aws kms get-key-policy --key-id <key-id> --policy-name default` (we'll include JSON diffs).

maria: Chain-of-custody: we'll produce manifest.json + sign with our internal sig:v1 key. Each artifact will have sha256, created_by, artifact_type, S3 presigned link (7d). We'll also produce control mapping doc linking artifacts to SOC2 and ISO controls (e.g., CC6.1, A.9.2).

auditor_jane: Also need approval evidence for RBAC changes (ticket and approver comments). Approval timestamped comment + screenshot is required.

maria: Approval tickets: CHG-7890 and INC-3245. We'll export the comment history and a redacted screenshot of the approval.

deploy-bot: Deployment event: rbac-controller v2.3.1 -> prod (canary) at 2024-10-05T02:12:45Z by maria via CI/CD.

sam: I'll include the Splunk saved search id for replay: `rbac_rolebinding_changes_prod_oct_2024`. Also attaching a sample CSV in this thread (note: not full export).

maria: Plan: bundle = [rbac_diff.csv, kms_events.csv, key_rotation_proof.pdf, manifest.json.sig, jira_comments_export.json, incident_mapping.csv, kms_policy_snapshot.json]. ETA: EOD Friday for full bundle; subset (RBAC diffs + KMS decrypt events) available tomorrow morning. /cc @ashley

auditor_jane: Tomorrow subset would be great, thanks :thumbsup:

ashley: One heads-up — there was an anomalous decrypt event on 2024-10-03 that we already investigated. It maps to emergency access for IR-2024-73; we'll include the triage note and justification.

sam: Repro guidance: use service account `splunk-exporter@redwood` to pull via saved search or API. Savedsearch id: `rbac_rolebinding_changes_prod_oct_2024`.

maria: Final checklist for package: rbac_diff.csv, kms_events.csv, key_rotation_proof.pdf, manifest.json.sig, jira_comments_export.json, incident_mapping.csv. We'll redact IPs / personal emails and note redaction in the manifest.

auditor_jane: One last ask — include the KMS key policy snapshot as-of rotation time so I can verify least-privilege.

ashley: Will do. We'll run `aws kms get-key-policy --key-id <id> --policy-name default` for current and preserved copies and include a diff between revisions.

auditor_jane: Perfect, appreciate the quick turnaround.
